ops.title: SECURITY P1: wire accept loop runs the handshake inline — an unauthenticated peer that sends nothing blocks every accept for 10s
ops.description:
wire/server.go:405-418 calls startConnection INLINE in the accept loop. Inside, :445 sets a deadline of defaultHandshakeTimeout (10s, wire/server.go:54) and :449 blocks in readClientHello — a network read from the peer — BEFORE PeerFromConn (:457) and before any trust check (:463).

So any process that opens the socket and sends nothing stops every other accept for 10 seconds, and a loop of them stops the daemon accepting anyone at all. No authentication is required to trigger it: the block happens before the peer is identified.

Found during the peer-verification research (cc-notes note bfc1789) and confirmed by direct read. Independent of that decision — this is live in the shipped tree today.

Fix: go s.startConnection(...), plus a pre-verification connection cap (its own named counter bounding unverified handshakes in flight, derived from Concurrency — rejecting an unverified handshake is always safe, so the cap cannot starve a verified peer).

Do NOT move session-capacity acquisition earlier as part of this: wire/server.go:501 must stay after verifyPeer at :463. The per-role capacity-1 reservation (:356-360) is what keeps Stop/Receipt/Readiness/Handoff and the trust-gated Drain verb reachable under flood, and identity.Role is peer-supplied, so anything acquired before verification is a denial primitive an unverified peer can hold.

The redesign fixes this in phase 1 (BUILD-ORDER, "Lands (wire, same phase)"). This task tracks the exposure in the shipped tree until the cut lands.

ops.text: startConnection no longer runs inline in the accept loop
a connection that sends nothing does not delay other accepts, proven by a test that is red before the fix
unverified handshakes in flight are bounded by a named counter derived from Concurrency
session capacity acquisition still happens after verifyPeer, pinned by a test that an unverified peer cannot consume a protected role slot
